name: Chainflip
description: Chainflip is a cross-chain AMM protocol that allows users to swap tokens between different blockchains.

methodology.UserFees: Ingress, Egress, and Broker fees paid by the user per swap
methodology.Fees: Includes Swap, Broker, Ingress, Egress and Network Fees for Buy/Burn Mechanism
methodology.Revenue: Fees collected from burning $FLIP. This is a fixed percentage of swap value.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Protocol keeps no fees, network fees are entirely used to buy and burn $FLIP.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees collected by the LPs + Broker, Ingress and Egress fees

Fees.Swap Fees: Swap fees paid by users to LP.
Fees.Ingress, Egress, Broker Fees: Broker, Ingress, Egress fees paid by users.

SupplySideRevenue.Ingress, Egress, Broker Fees: Broker, Ingress, Egress fees paid by users.

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Network Fees are used for Buy/Burn $FLIP.
